[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-p5[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Commit finalizer stops failing agents whose work actually landed[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]An agent whose work is committed and pushed is never marked FAILED [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]by the commit finalizer's discarded-work guard. Commit provenance [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]survives conflict resolution, the finalizer decides attribution [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from evidence the run itself owns rather than from commit-message [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]footers alone, and a concurrent agent's activity in a shared clone [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]can no longer be misread as this agent discarding its work.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]commit_finalizer_attribution.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/commit_finalizer_attribution.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-p5[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-p5/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the SASE commit footer survive conflict resolution[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]restamp[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]restamp: verify and re-stamp the run's SASE_* provenance footer onto [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]HEAD during `sase stitch create --resume`, before the push, so a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hand-resolved rebase conflict can no longer land the run's own commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unattributed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Record a run-owned commit ledger[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ledger[dim] · [dim][/dim]after restamp[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger: persist every commit SHA this run created or finalized into the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]agent artifacts directory, including the resume path that currently [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]records a null result, so later stages have positive proof of what the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run committed.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decide attribution from run-owned evidence[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]guard[dim] · [dim][/dim]after ledger[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]guard: teach the discarded-work guard to consult the run-owned commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ledger before declaring a discard, so a commit the run provably created [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]counts as attributable even when its footer is missing.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop blaming an agent for concurrent activity in shared clones[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]shared[dim] · [dim][/dim]after guard[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]shared: classify foreign-agent and already-published transitions in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]machine-wide clones as races rather than discards, extending the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exemption beyond sdd-kind repos and putting the relaxation behind a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]feature flag.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Actionable diagnostics and regression coverage[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]hardening[dim] · [dim][/dim]after shared[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]hardening: replace the guard's dead-end failure text with an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]operator-actionable diagnostic, add end-to-end regressions reproducing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]both failure clusters, and refresh the affected docs.[/#D7D7AF]
